criteria.AC-01: Actual Ubuntu/UBI native full package inventories, payload and controller/candidate/image/Run identities share one frozen record and match original JSON/TXT exporter hashes. Helper/provisioner tools remain separate execution provenance.
criteria.AC-02: Missing optional package and wrong expected native version retain failed rows; failed collector and wrong expected target identity retain dependent unverified rows with the actual primary failure.
criteria.AC-03: Reports identify actual container userland and host-shared kernel, without VM installation, ISO boot, operating-system STIG or scanner claims.

limitations: Original helper transport captures remain private; public evidence retains their bounded hashes/metadata. The actual runtime domain report replays them before accepting the exporter.
Canonical observed packet hashes and both exporter hashes are independently checked by the reviewed pure renderer during delivery preparation.
Controlled wrong expected version/identity is not package damage or ownership adoption. A negative harness pass preserves underlying failure.
Full package inventory describes target userland; helper/build tools and shared kernel are separate. No VM/ISO/scanner/production acceptance.
UBI AUDIT_WRITE allows owned authentication audit records in the shared kernel audit log; Ubuntu retains its original policy.
Disk/usage observations are samples, not reserved resources or hard storage quotas. Safe scanning is scoped, not comprehensive.

source_fixtures.scope: Source fixtures; actual SSH/Ansible observations are separate. Skips remain unverified.
